messages:
tara: Noticed quota attribution drops to 'unknown' when clients hit the fallback routing path and the proxy strips route metadata. Impacting org-level billing dashboards. Anyone tracking?
ben: Yup, saw this in SRE alerts last night during a traffic spike. Quick repro: send `X-RD-Route: org-123` + force fallback -> console shows fallback bucket.
hao: The shim drops route to avoid leaking internal route tags downstream. That was intentional but clearly breaks billing. Two choices: forward minimal identifier or keep full route.
rachel: We shouldn't forward raw route (PII). Propose forwarding `X-RD-Route-Hash` (short hmac) and `X-RD-Route-Key` (version). Backend maps hash -> org for billing.
tara: SDKs must provide an opt-in `preserve_route_on_fallback` flag so defaults don't change. DevEx should add helpers for py/ts/go.
ben: Ops concerns: rotation. Keys must be rotateable and backend needs grace window for old keys. Also need audit logs when orgs enable preserve.
hao: I'll update ledger ingestion to accept route_hash and key version; add dedupe and ensure no plaintext stored.
rachel: UX: console should surface when attribution is based on hash and offer a per-org toggle to enable/disable. Add a banner during rollout so support can triage billing questions.
tara: Test plan: unit tests for SDK flag, e2e that verifies ledger attribution, and canary rollout to non-prod orgs. I'll schedule a 30m sync.
devex-bot: note 9: will add python/ts helper stubs and changelog entry.
ops-bot: canary scheduled for 2024-09-01T03:00Z (non-prod)
tara: thanks all :thumbsup:
